# std/math
Trigonometric, exponential, logarithmic, and rounding functions.
All functions are pure (no effects).

Added in v0.5.10

## Exports

  sin(float) -> float
    sin: Compute sine of angle in radians

  cos(float) -> float
    cos: Compute cosine of angle in radians

  tan(float) -> float
    tan: Compute tangent of angle in radians

  asin(float) -> float
    asin: Compute arcsine (inverse sine) returning radians

  acos(float) -> float
    acos: Compute arccosine (inverse cosine) returning radians

  atan(float) -> float
    atan: Compute arctangent (inverse tangent) returning radians

  atan2(float, float) -> float
    atan2: Compute two-argument arctangent for angle calculation

  sqrt(float) -> float
    sqrt: Compute square root

  pow(float, float) -> float
    pow: Compute x raised to the power y

  exp(float) -> float
    exp: Compute e^x (exponential function)

  log(float) -> float
    log: Compute natural logarithm (base e)

  log10(float) -> float
    log10: Compute base-10 logarithm

  floor(float) -> float
    floor: Round down to nearest integer

  ceil(float) -> float
    ceil: Round up to nearest integer

  round(float) -> float
    round: Round to nearest integer (half away from zero)

  floatToInt(float) -> int
    floatToInt: Convert float to int (truncates toward zero)

  intToFloat(int) -> float
    intToFloat: Convert int to float

  abs_Float(float) -> float
    abs_Float: Compute absolute value of a float

  abs_Int(int) -> int
    abs_Int: Compute absolute value of an integer

  PI(()) -> float
    PI: Return the mathematical constant PI (3.14159...)

  E(()) -> float
    E: Return Euler's number e (2.71828...)

  isNaN(float) -> bool
    isNaN: true when x is NaN (e.g. 0.0 / 0.0, sqrt(-1.0)).

  bitwiseOr(int, int) -> int
    bitwiseOr: Bitwise OR of two integers.

  shiftRightLogical(int, int) -> int
    shiftRightLogical: logical (zero-filling) right shift — the `>>>` of

## Usage

  import std/math (sin)
  -- or --
  import std/math as Math
